title: crdm-detect phrase signals
description: The mechanical implementation of the crdm-detect skill's phrase signals (cat-harness-tools src/crdm/detect-signals.ts): given an issue's text it says whether the text reads as a feature request, and in which categories. Declared as a system under test for dogfood test plan #1 (bean folio-assistant-ff09). It never judges its own output: case verdicts come from comparing it with the corpus's adjudicated labels, written by a tester that is not this actor. Air-gapped: it reads text and nothing else.
